name: Write a voice guide from your documents and check copy
why: Builds a voice guide from a client's own documents and checks new drafts against it, the same job as this kit's voice profile skill.

name: Brand voice one-pager writer
why: A one-page voice guide with word lists and before and after lines, useful when a business needs a house voice as well as the founder's.

name: Brand voice reviewer
why: Reviews each draft against the voice and fixes only the lines that slip, like the voice match edit prompt.

name: Write your founder story and cut it to what moves
why: Maps the true facts of how a founder started into a story and cuts it, a common first ghostwriting deliverable.

name: Write something experts admire and newcomers enjoy
why: Helps with the curse of knowledge: a draft that keeps experts' respect while newcomers can follow it.

name: X and LinkedIn post pair writer
why: Turns one idea into a LinkedIn post and an X post that each fit their place, for clients active on both.

name: Write an annual letter with long-term priorities and metrics
why: A founder's annual letter from the year's real numbers, a classic ghostwritten piece.

name: Annual letter writer
why: A shorter annual letter that leads with bad news and owns mistakes, in the owner's voice.

name: Read-aloud speech shaper
why: Shapes notes into a speech made to be heard, for clients who need a talk or toast as well as written pieces.

name: Long-form draft editor
why: Edits a finished article, talk or chapter in rounds and lists what is left, useful before the client's final read.

name: Make a daily writing habit that lasts
why: For authors who want to write parts of their book themselves alongside the ghostwriter.

name: Price a course or ebook and write its launch emails
why: Prices a book or ebook and writes honest launch emails, the next step after the manuscript.
